comparison.objective: Refit a driveshaft slip yoke onto a splined shaft with both yokes in phase.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotational alignment of splines followed by axial insertion and seating.
comparison.success_condition: Yoke reaches the collar and satisfies phase-angle and seated-depth scoring after release.
comparison.reason: Despite fine rotational alignment, this is keyed insertion and seating. It does not include an unlock-adjust-lock sequence or iterative testing of impact absorption.
